name: forge
description: Engineering workflow for one repository in the VS Code Agents window, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Claude Code (GitHub Issues, pull requests, and Actions with gh): full research and investigation for every new ticket, revision-aware review gates with one plain document each, a ticket canvas in the browser, named ticket worktrees and session titles, a ticket board skill for any session, and a repository wiki. Existing tickets retain their original process. Say 'set up forge' to seed the config in the repository wiki.
